part.text:
Fixed the localized float alignment bug in `include/fmt/format.h:2703`.

The width calculation counted thousands separators using all significand digits instead of only the integral digits. It now uses `exp` (the integral-part length), matching what `write_significand` actually groups.

Validated: all 20 test suites pass, including the localized-double cases.
